name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
summary: In Coldridge Valley, a dispatch travels from Talin Keeneye's post to Grelin Whitebeard's camp. You carry it down the southeastern road, keeping the mountaineers in touch with Ironforge.

sections.title: A Link to the Mountain
sections.body: Anvilmar is Coldridge Valley's center of rule. From there, field scouts and sentries carry dispatches along the trails between the high passes and Ironforge.

sections.title: Word for Whitebeard
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard keeps a small camp southeast of Talin Keeneye's post. Veteran mountaineers at these remote watchpoints face freezing drifts and steady trogg harassment. Regular letters keep them abreast of affairs across Dun Morogh and the kingdom beyond.

faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard is a dwarven veteran at an outpost along Coldridge Valley's southeastern road. He watches the roads and guards against troggs and beasts.
The letter came from Ironforge, the dwarven capital. Local runners and sentries carried it through Coldridge Valley and down the mountain passes to its recipient.

faq.q: Why is mail delivered by foot here?
faq.answer: Foot couriers carry mail through Coldridge Valley because the surrounding peaks cut it off from Dun Morogh's main roads. Trusted travelers and mountaineers bring dispatches by hand to the field camps.

faq.q: Where is Grelin Whitebeard's camp located?
faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard's camp lies farther down the southeastern road through Coldridge Valley, past the hunting and scouting grounds of the upper pass.

faq.q: Who handed off the letter to deliver to Grelin?
faq.answer: Talin Keeneye, a hunter and scout stationed along the pass, handed you the letter. It came from the staging grounds near Anvilmar.

faq.q: What happens after Grelin receives his mail?
faq.answer: After Grelin receives news from Ironforge, he turns to the dangers in the valley. He often directs recruits against Frostmane trolls and troggs.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you rely on dispatches from King Magni's seat in Ironforge to coordinate Dun Morogh's defenses.
As an Alliance member, you rely on courier routes through snowy passes to carry orders and vital intelligence to remote scouts.
